chunks: He could take you away if He pleased and bring a new creation (in your place).

key_terms.يُذْهِبْکُمْ: He takes you away / removes you

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He can bring a new creation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rum (often cited in Tafsir al-Mizan) underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty (Mashiyyah) over existence, linking the concept of 'new creation' to both the physical resurrection and the spiritual renewal of the soul. It serves as a profound reminder of human transience (Fana) and the inevitability of the Hereafter, encouraging believers to reflect on their accountability before the Creator who can effortlessly replace them.
